The popup shows what is happening while you watch it, and the About card says what this is.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **The instance card updates while the popup is open.** It fetched the status exactly once, when the window opened, and never again: so a card said "waiting, 19 files" and went on saying it while a download ran behind it. Reported as *"Ich seh nach wie vor auch keine downloadaktivität im browser"*, and the reason was not that there was nothing to show. The line the extension draws was correct; it was a photograph. It now refreshes every two seconds for as long as the window is open, and asks nothing at all while nobody is looking.

## ✨ Added

- **A status badge on every instance card:** the word, on a ground in that status's own colour, beside the name. It replaces a bare coloured dot on the app's own card and arrives here in the same round so the two surfaces draw one object. A dot asks the reader to know the colour code; the word carries the meaning and the colour carries the urgency.
- **The About card says what this is.** Written in evenings and weekends, on more coffee than is strictly advisable. There is a button for the coffee now, and the two report routes have a glyph each.

## 📋 Installing it in Chrome

**Chrome does not put a newly loaded extension in the toolbar.** It says "extension loaded" and then deliberately shows no icon: the extension sits behind the puzzle-piece button at the right of the address bar until you click the pin beside it there. That reads exactly like a failed install, and has been reported as one three times. Measured on Chrome 151 rather than assumed: the extension reports itself as enabled with no install warnings and no manifest errors, and simply not on the toolbar.

The step is now in the instructions, both in **Settings › Browser & App** and in the repository's own README.

Settings live under **Extension options › About this browser extension**.
